description: Pledge amount_usd to a bounty or pot with email or agent_key. Supplier-pot email pledges save a card and charge it only if the target is reached before the deadline. Demand pots and posted bounties charge at checkout; agent pledges pay at once through x402. The platform fee applies to the funded total at settlement. Returns 409 while a bounty is being taken down. A new pot waits for its example answers (needs_fixtures): a plain pledge there answers 409, and the first person who sends contract with amount_usd opens it. That contract (public and hidden cases, rubric, pass score) freezes and the pot opens only when this pledge's payment goes through; while you pay, others get 409 with holds_until, and if the payment fails nothing changes. A pot that a key asked for is opened only by that key. contract on an open pot answers 409 with pledge_url: join it as it is. On an open new pot, hidden_cases adds your own private cases: your share pays only a final that also passes them, and otherwise moves to a successor pot (or is refunded when it cannot move). Cases that contradict a public case are refused.
